orchestrator.description: Main session role, not a delegate: takes intake from the owner, routes each task to the one role that owns it, sequences the work, synthesizes results and accepts or returns them.
orchestrator.allowed-tools: Agent(researcher, builder, owner-auditor, sensor, repurposer), Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit, Skill, Workflow

researcher.description: Delegate research, analysis and specs: gather evidence, test a thesis, and turn findings into a build-ready spec with a self-scored rubric. Not for building software or producing content.
researcher.allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob, WebFetch, WebSearch, Write, Edit, Bash, Skill

builder.description: Delegate code, automation and test work that changes files: reads before writing, makes surgical changes, and returns a working artifact with verification output. Works in an isolated git worktree.
builder.allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit, Bash, Skill

owner-auditor.description: Delegate an audit of what the agent system costs its owner: interventions, time and repeated corrections. Returns a burden ledger, the top defect, one leverage fix and the decision left to the owner. Reads anything; writes only under memory/.

sensor.description: Delegate reading public audience evidence (comments, threads, reviews) into one periodic brief with verbatim language and one falsifiable bet. Read-only: no account access, no replies, no content creation.
sensor.disallowed-tools: Write, Edit, NotebookEdit, Bash, PowerShell, mcp__*

repurposer.description: Delegate turning one approved source piece into platform-native drafts, in the platform order set in the project config. Drafts only: it never posts, uploads, schedules or invents material.
repurposer.allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit, Skill

labs/ops.name: ops-skills
labs/ops.description: Session close-out and loop briefs, extracted from a working agent team. Experimental until each skill passes its eval.

labs/quality.name: quality-skills
labs/quality.description: A voice audit that checks drafts against the owner's voice rules. Experimental until it passes its eval.

labs/knowledge.name: knowledge-skills
labs/knowledge.description: Cross-references notes in a knowledge base. Experimental until it passes its eval.

labs/audience.name: audience-skills
labs/audience.description: Scheduling and writing the sensor's audience brief. Experimental until each skill passes its eval.
